fullDescription: A Swiss minimalist editorial style guide with a focus on high-impact typography, asymmetrical grids, and refined micro-interactions. Characterized by a neutral color palette (off-whites, grays, and deep blacks), 'echoed' text layers for depth, and grayscale-to-color image reveals. This design is ideal for high-end academic institutions, architectural portfolios, design agencies, or luxury real estate brands looking for a sophisticated, structured, and modern presentation.

structured.summary: A minimalist, editorial-inspired design system utilizing a neutral gray/white palette, bold geometric headers with layered 'echo' effects, and an asymmetrical grid for visual interest. The system emphasizes whitespace, high-contrast typography, and smooth, high-duration animations.

style.description: The style is 'Swiss Minimalist' meets 'Modern Editorial'. It pairs the geometric 'Clash Display' for headings with the clean 'Satoshi' sans-serif for body text. Colors are primarily monochromatic: #f2f2f2 (Base), #111111 (Primary Text), and varying shades of gray (#bfbfbf to #d9d9d9) for layering. Interactions use a consistent cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1) curve over 700ms for a premium, heavy-yet-fluid feel.
style.prompt: Create a design system using a neutral palette: Background #f2f2f2, Primary Text #111111, Secondary Text #838282, and Accent Dark #1e1e1e. Use 'Clash Display' for bold, tight-kerning headings (letter-spacing: -0.05em) and 'Satoshi' for body text (letter-spacing: 0.02em, line-height: 1.7). Implement an 'echo' text effect using absolute-positioned layers with offsets (-0.05em to -0.20em) in shades of gray (#bfbfbf, #c9c9c9, #d1d1d1, #d9d9d9). All transitions must use cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1) with a duration of 700ms. Hover effects on images should include a clip-path inset (2% 2% 2% 2%), a grayscale reduction (20% to 0%), and a 1.05x scale transform.

layout_and_structure.description: The layout follows a structured hierarchy starting with a floating navigation, an oversized typographic hero section, followed by wide-margin editorial content, a four-column stats bar, and a dynamic asymmetrical image showcase grid.

prompts.prompt: Fixed 80px height header with #f2f2f2/90 background and 24px backdrop-blur. 1440px max-width container with 48px horizontal padding. Include a logo area with a vertically stacked brand name (Clash Display, 20px) and a sub-brand name (10px, tracking-widest). Navigation links use 14px bold uppercase text with 150ms color transition on hover. Right-side CTA is a pill-shaped button with 1px border and 32px horizontal padding, transitioning to a solid #111111 background on hover.

Minimum 90vh height, flex-column layout. Centered 'Est' label with 0.3em tracking and horizontal line divider (w-32, opacity-20). Main headlines should be extremely large (9vw or 160px) in Clash Display, uppercase, with 4-5 layers of 'echo' text stacked behind. Include a bottom-aligned italicized sub-caption in a 24px font size with medium weight and tight tracking.

48px padding section with a vertical 96px separator line leading into a 6xl Clash Display heading. Underline key phrases with a 1px decoration and 8px offset. Below, use a 12-column grid: 4 columns for small, boxed stat cards (border #111111/10) and 8 columns for two paragraphs of lead text (24px and 18px respectively) and a flex-row of quantitative metrics separated by 1px vertical dividers.

A horizontal band with top/bottom 1px borders (#111111/10). 4-column grid where each cell is centered, featuring a 5xl bold heading and a 12px black-weight uppercase label. On hover, the cell background transitions to pure white (#ffffff) with a 700ms duration.

12-column asymmetrical grid with 32px gaps and 250px auto-rows. Elements: 1) 8-column/2-row rectangle with bottom-left text. 2) 4-column/2-row perfect circle (rounded-full) with centered icon and description overlay. 3) 5-column/2-row rectangle. 4) 7-column/2-row rectangle with centered 6xl title overlay. All images must feature the 'image-reveal' behavior (700ms bezier, 1.05x scale, clip-path inset).

Dark mode section (#1e1e1e) with #f6f6f6/60 text. 4-column grid: 1) Large inverted logo and brand summary. 2) Navigation links. 3) Resource links. 4) Contact info with Lucide icons. Include a bottom copyright bar with 11px uppercase tracking-widest text and 30% opacity.

special_ui_components.description: Layered typographic effect creating a sense of motion or 3D depth.
special_ui_components.prompt: Wrap the primary text in a relative container. Create 4 absolute-positioned 'echo' layers behind the main text. Each layer should have a specific offset: Layer 1 (-0.05em, -0.05em), Layer 2 (-0.10em, -0.10em), Layer 3 (-0.15em, -0.15em), Layer 4 (-0.20em, -0.20em). Assign each layer a decreasing shade of gray (#bfbfbf, #c9c9c9, #d1d1d1, #d9d9d9) to simulate a depth gradient.

special_ui_components.description: Interactive image container with scale and cropping effects.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a container with 'overflow: hidden' and a default 'clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0)'. Inside, place an image with 'filter: grayscale(20%)'. On hover: 1) Transition clip-path to 'inset(2% 2% 2% 2%)'. 2) Scale image to 1.05. 3) Remove grayscale filter. All transitions must use cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1) at 700ms.

special_ui_components.description: Card with a rotating geometric icon on hover.
special_ui_components.prompt: Container: padding 64px, border #1e1e1e/10, flex-column, min-height 500px. Feature a 64px square or circular icon container with a 2px border inside. On card hover, rotate the icon container by 12 degrees. Include a bottom-aligned 'Explore' link with a horizontal line that grows from 0 to 32px wide on hover.
